title: Prove an exact H6 asymmetric U9 factor and compensation splice
body:
## Summary

- Replace sixteen source features in the fixed H6 factor with two pure-bank U9 gathers and transform the scatter rows contragrediently. The complete operator is unchanged; the full local histogram change is `{8:4336,9:32,16:-2160,17:-32}`, saving 128 rank units with every extra source visit charged.
- Supply phase-correct native recipes and a legal arbitrary-dirt splice into the inherited compensation chronology. The new K word replaces the old outer source-to-FULL and target-cap phases.
- Keep this as one isolated package, with a written proof, independent AI reviews, immutable predecessor bytes and read-only portable replay.

## Scope and limits

This is a finite exact construction and a phasewise full-bucket proof. The 227,312,640 compensation helpers remain; no new selected κ or complete supplier is claimed. Ordinary helpers are logically restored at FULL with physical output Fd. Paid copied-total erasure, physical wrappers, owner placement, tape/routing costs, approximate-child composite precision and joint BIT admission remain separate obligations. The f+19 grid bound applies only to standalone K with exact children. The full multi-billion-event network is not materialized.

The detailed receipts are the evidence for this single operator substitution. Frozen reports retain their preparation-time local-only and earlier open-gate statements; the current scope is the package README and PROOF.md.

## Test plan

- [x] Source-bound Python 3.12 / NumPy 2.3.5 executions of all six mathematical stages at `de2ba3f4558d66cf0909712e7832a1d5b9aa037e`; their sources remain byte-identical at the current head. The first hosted run also passed all six stages.
- [x] Normal and optimized cache controls through the actual repository launcher after fixing creation of nested cache directories; source-history preflight passed at `1bcc4f8261d2dc322c98fa9e44c4ced43cd1cd95`.
- [x] All 665,856 polynomial coefficients and 30,960 port rows; 18 factor controls.
- [x] Regenerate 548 new recipes and 272 baselines; exact serialized bytes, signed Paulis, full Gaussian phase vectors, inverse/chain checks and seven native defect classes. Separate 820-operator frozen replay rejects three global-phase mutations without lowering.
- [x] Both 1,316-column integrated compensation fixtures and six controls; exact adapter and standalone precision ledgers.
- [x] Repository metadata, source-history preflight and unchanged committed inputs.
- [x] Independent AI algebra/native/portability review; no human peer review or formal-kernel certification.
- [x] [Automatic GitHub CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39237696165) passed on current head `1bcc4f8261d2dc322c98fa9e44c4ced43cd1cd95`, including the complete registered replay and unchanged-input check. The first run passed every mathematical stage but failed the cache-test directory setup under the runner's private cache prefix. The reviewed follow-up fixes that fixture and reallocates timeout headroom within the unchanged 1,140-second total; mathematical sources and coverage are unchanged.

## Sources and credit

Scientific pin: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. `SOURCES.json` pins the upstream Git blobs; `FROZEN-SHA256.json` binds every retained source and receipt. The fresh overlap scan covered all 729 open PRs and 2,593 discussion records with no same scoped construction found; it is not a novelty certificate.

Credit to Dominik Scholz / [PR606](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/606) for H6 geometry and factor, DreamingOfClouds for the [H6 proposal](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18914612), the retained H6 compensation network, Zhihao Chen / [PR425](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/425) and icekylinx / [PR531](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/531) for inherited exact Clifford machinery. Original source notices are retained. Ross Richardson's new factor, lowering audit and splice were prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
